verdicts.reason: The Orbit Determination Engine produces the Doppler Residual Report, and the Flight Dynamics Team uses the uniquely corresponding residual report.
The Telemetry Ingest Service produces the Pass Replay Packet, which the Spacecraft Operations Team uses for anomaly reconstruction.
The Payload Calibration Team sends the Calibration Patch Bundle, and the Product Quality Service uses the patch bundle to update its checks.
The Ground Network Manager issues the Antenna Deicing Notice, and the Spacecraft Operations Team uses it to assess planned support.
The Flight Dynamics Facility sends the Star Tracker Mask File, and the Command Validation Gateway accepts the corresponding mask file subject to its checks.
The Product Quality Service produces the Product Hold List, and the User Services Portal uses it to prevent release of affected products.
The Flight Dynamics Team produces the Ephemeris Delta Note, and the Mission Planning System applies the corresponding delta note during schedule validation.
The Cybersecurity Desk sends the Security Exception Ticket, and the Network Control System uses it to restrict affected transfer paths.
The Orbit Determination Engine produces the Laser Retroreflector Window, and the Mission Planning System treats the corresponding window as a constrained planning input.
The Long Term Archive sends the Storage Watermark Snapshot, which the Backup Processing Cluster uses to verify recovery capacity.
The document introduces Bluebell as an alias for the Mission Control Center and uses it for that entity in the link sentence.
The document identifies Mistral as another name for the Flight Dynamics Facility, and the link sentence uses it in that role.
The document identifies Forgehouse as the Payload Processing Facility, and the link sentence uses it for that facility.
The document identifies Lantern as the Network Control System, and the link sentence uses it for that system.
The document identifies Cedar as another name for the Mission Planning System, and the link sentence uses it for that system.
The document identifies Osprey as another name for the Command Validation Gateway, and the link sentence uses it for that gateway.
The document identifies Granite as another name for the Long Term Archive, and the link sentence uses it for that archive.
The document identifies Juniper as another name for the Ground Network Manager, and the link sentence uses it for that manager.
The link sentence explicitly names the North S-Band Antenna, rather than the South S-Band Antenna.
The link sentence explicitly names the Primary Processing Cluster, rather than the Backup Processing Cluster.
